{{Quote|You know how to play a Bontormian Klesplong? Well, it doesn't really matter. If you can play any sort of instrument, I got a gig for you.|A performance organizer, to an entertainer|<ref name="SWG:RIYS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal|Entertainer|Rhythm In Your Soul}}</ref>}}
The '''Bontormian klesplong'''<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|85|Bontormian klesplong}}</ref> was a complicated musical instrument from the [[Bontormia system/Legends|Bontormia system]]. It was built from a [[Xloff horn]], a [[Troomic sound tube]], and a [[Plandl horn]]. A [[cymbal]] and a [[radion modulator]] could be added to accentuate the sound a bit more. [[Ak-rev/Legends|Ak-rev]] was in possession of a klesplong.
